title: Add automatic FTS5 quorum fallback for 4+ word queries when strict=False

sections.what: In Searcher.keyword(), when match_all=True (and strict=False, no explicit must_terms) with >= 4 tokens returns < limit hits, run a second FTS pass requiring at least ceil(len(tokens) * 0.5) distinct query tokens at 0.75x FTS weight.
sections.why: Multi-word natural-language queries hit a 0-result FTS cliff when a single word is missing under AND, while pure OR floods FTS with common words.
sections.verify: Run pytest tests/test_codesearch_db.py covering multi-word quorum fallback with strict=False vs strict=True.

acceptance.text: When match_all=True, strict=False, no must_terms, and len(tokens) >= 4 yields < limit hits, Searcher.keyword runs a quorum pass requiring >= ceil(0.5 * len(tokens)) distinct query tokens at 0.75x FTS weight.
strict=True never triggers quorum relaxation and preserves exact AND semantics.
Unit tests cover 5+ word queries hitting quorum fallback when strict=False vs 0 hits when strict=True.
